# Every Android TV and Google TV, whatever the brand: Google and AOSP packages
# Generated by debloat/research/build-lists.py on 2026-10-25 from debloat/research/tcl-hisense-xiaomi.md and debloat/research/google-chromecast-onn-fire-tv.md. Edit freely; rerunning overwrites.
#
#   bloat     hidden by ./debloat.sh by default
#   optional  hidden only with --include <group> (or --include all)
#   keep      left alone; debloat.sh refuses it
#   never     breaks the TV; debloat.sh refuses it (a trailing * matches every package starting with it)
#
